title: Homesite Reservation Agreement — Eligibility Clauses
content:
The following clauses govern whether a Homesite Reservation may be written.

**1. Premium class and lot premium.** A homesite is reserved in the premium class the community site plan assigns it, and the lot premium written on the reservation must sit between the class's lowest and highest lot premium.

**2. Age of the pre-qualification letter.** The reservation is written no later than the class's maximum pre-qualification letter age, in calendar days, after the date printed on the pre-qualification letter. The day after the letter date is day one, and a reservation on the last counted day is accepted. The date relied on is the date printed on the buyer's lender pre-qualification letter, as entered on the reservation record for this buyer.

**3. Occupancy intent.** An occupancy intent of investor is accepted only where the class accepts investor reservations, and second home only where the class accepts second home reservations; owner occupant is always accepted.

**4. Channel.** A reservation placed through the online channel is accepted only where the class allows online reservation; otherwise it must be placed at the sales center.

**5. Reserving the same homesite again.** A buyer who released or let expire a reservation on the same community and lot may reserve it again only where the class allows the same buyer to reserve the same homesite again, and the buyer has no reservation in status released or expired on that same community and lot number whose end date falls within the class's wait period, that is, the trailing number of calendar days equal to the class wait ending on the current date.

**6. Hold expiry date at writing.** The clause "the hold expiry date written is the reservation date plus the class's initial hold days" is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded by the current basis on which the hold expiry date is written when the hold is activated.

## Letter-age boundary (hypothetical class maximum of 45 days)

| Letter date | Reservation date | Day count | Accepted |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 15 April | day 45 (the last counted day) | Yes |
| 1 March | 16 April | day 46 | No, the condition is not met |
| 1 March | 2 March | day 1 | Yes |

## Points of judgement

- **Which date starts the count?** The date printed on the pre-qualification letter; the following day is day one.
- **Is the last day inside?** Yes, a reservation on the last counted day is accepted.
- **Can an owner occupant be refused on intent?** No, owner occupant is always accepted under clause 3.

superseded_clauses: The hold expiry date written is the reservation date plus initial_hold_days.
